instruction: A clean studio portrait photograph captured in a medium shot at eye-level against a plain white background. On the right, the brunette woman in the grey-brown long-sleeve top (R2) leans in close, resting her head against the blonde woman's shoulder with her eyes closed in a peaceful smile. The brunette woman (R2) wraps her arm around the blonde woman (R1), who holds her arms crossed in front. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting, creating a warm, clean aesthetic.
